description: This file defines the Auditable interface for audit tracking within the project, specifying methods to get and set the audit section.

classes.name: Auditable
classes.description: Interface for objects that can be audited, providing methods to access and modify audit information.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section for the object.
